title: 주간 생산량 추이 (3~8월)
code:
for bar in ax.patches:
    x_val = bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2
    if x_val >= 14:
        bar.set_color('orange')
    else:
        bar.set_color('blue')
# Calculate averages from the drawn data
vals = [b.get_height() for b in ax.patches]
xs = [b.get_x() + b.get_width()/2 for b in ax.patches]
mask1 = [x < 14 for x in xs]
mask2 = [x >= 14 for x in xs]
avg1 = sum(v for v, m in zip(vals, mask1) if m) / sum(mask1) if sum(mask1) > 0 else 0
avg2 = sum(v for v, m in zip(vals, mask2) if m) / sum(mask2) if sum(mask2) > 0 else 0
ax.axhline(avg1, color='gray', linestyle='--', label=f'Avg 1-13: {avg1:.1f}')
ax.axhline(avg2, color='black', linestyle=':', label=f'Avg 14-26: {avg2:.1f}')
ax.legend(loc='best')
